assumptions: Period analysed is 12 Oct 2026 only (2026-10-12 to 2026-10-12).
A transaction means a payment attempt, counted once per unique attempt.
caveats: Duplicate records on 12 Oct: 341 attempts were ingested twice (11,704 raw rows vs 11,363 unique attempts, +3.0%). Paysight counts each attempt once. The duplicates were removed in the clean view, keeping the first ingestion.

facts.text: There were 11,363 unique payment attempts on 12 Oct 2026.
